topic: Julho das Pretas: o mês que celebra a resistência, a liderança e a luta das mulheres negras Revista Raça Brasil
insights: Julho das Pretas was established in 2013 by Odara – Instituto da Mulher Negra to celebrate the resistance and leadership of Black women.
The movement highlights gender and racial inequalities while promoting political activism among Black women.
The 2022 edition marked the 10th anniversary of Julho das Pretas.
The celebration culminates on July 25, recognized as the Day of Afro-Latin American and Caribbean Women.
Julho das Pretas includes a variety of activities organized by over 230 organizations across Brazil.

quotes.text: Julho das Pretas is a month of mobilization, memory, resistance, and celebration of the struggle of Black women.
The movement strengthens the fight of Black women for equality, representation, and social justice.

summary: Julho das Pretas is a significant movement in Brazil that celebrates the contributions and struggles of Black women, addressing critical issues of racial and gender inequality. Established in 2013, it has grown to include numerous organizations and activities aimed at promoting political activism and awareness.
